_comment: 26.2 alignment: upstream 1.21.1 used "parent": "builtin/entity", which carries NO display transforms. 26.2 removed builtin/entity, and porting it to minecraft:item/generated silently inherited that model's firstperson_righthand transform (rotation [0,-90,25], translation [1.13,3.2,1.13], scale 0.68). ItemStackRenderState.LayerRenderState#applyTransform applies itemTransform BEFORE the special renderer runs, so those vanilla offsets were stacked on top of TACZ's own first-person camera transform -> the held gun was rotated/offset away from the camera. A parentless model reproduces builtin/entity's identity transforms.
